title: Signal: SQL built by concatenation (elixir) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on concatenated SQL in elixir code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any concatenated query matches, including trusted assembly. Input trust needs human review.

examples.line: Repo.query!("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" <> name <> "'")
# audit: Repo.query!("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" <> name <> "'") present
# verified: Repo.query!("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = $1", [name])

fpNotes: Assembling fixed column lists or trusted fragments is the common false positive.
